item.title: Your weekly guide of things to do in and around Hall County
item.description: From art classes and Easter activities to community events and rallies, there's plenty of events in and around Hall County to add to your calendar this week. Here's are our top picks.

item.title: New metals supplier aims to serve customers ranging from businesses to hobbyists
item.description: A nationwide metals supplier serving a wide range of customers – from local manufacturers to hobbyists – has opened a location in South Hall.

item.title: Flowery Branch man charged with assaulting, kidnapping woman after date
item.description: A Flowery Branch man was arrested Thursday, March 19, after authorities say he assaulted a woman and kidnapped her by forcing her into his car and preventing her from leaving following a date.

item.title: Cody Ewing to challenge Dubnik in District 29 state House primary
item.description: Gainesville resident Cody Scott Ewing is running for the 29th District state House seat.

item.title: Shiv Sachdeva criticizes DA as ‘semi-retired’ as he looks to unseat longtime boss
item.description: After 18 years working under District Attorney Lee Darragh, veteran prosecutor Shiv Sachdeva is now running to replace him — and says the office needs a more active leader who is not “semi-retired.”

item.title: Hall County DA Lee Darragh defends record, age and leadership in reelection bid
item.description: District Attorney Lee Darragh is seeking another term as the top prosecutor for the Northeastern Judicial Circuit, arguing that his decades of experience, deep community ties and what he calls “one of the best offices in the state” make a change unnecessary and potentially disruptive.

item.title: Republican candidates for House, Senate debate in Flowery Branch
item.description: Republican candidates vying for the 9th Congressional District's U.S. House and U.S. Senate seats squared off Monday evening at the Venue at Friendship Springs in Flowery Branch.

item.title: High school baseball: Gainesville beats Seckinger to stretch win streak to six games
item.description: Red Elephants control their own destiny in Region 7-5A

item.title: Tennessee man reported missing near Amicalola Falls State Park
item.description: The Dawson County Sheriff's Office is searching for a missing man last seen near Amicalola Falls State Park, according to a Facebook post published Sunday.
